name: sonzai-sdk
description: Two skills for Sonzai SDK developers: (1) sonzai-sdk — wizard-driven, prescribes archetype + memory mode + capabilities, drives spec → review → plan. (2) full-auto — autonomous closed-loop: takes a meeting transcript, dispatches a builder subagent, exercises the built app (API + UI), feeds failures back until it works. Covers 7 archetypes, 20+ feature references, 10 decision aids, 9 migration playbooks.
